questions.q: A country has 24 million people in an area of 80,000 km². What is its population density?

questions.why: Pull factors attract migrants to a place; better-paid jobs are one. The others are push factors.

questions.q: Money sent home by migrants to their families is called:
questions.why: Remittances are an important benefit for the source area.

questions.q: Explain one negative impact of migration on the source area.
questions.model: Brain drain: skilled people such as doctors and engineers leave, so the country has a shortage of skills and its economy can slow.
points: valid impact (brain drain, ageing population, fewer workers, split families)
